result:
I searched the CRM. Reply Deutschland, valantic AG and Körber Digital all raised the same complaint.

The Reply complaint is an inbound email dated **18 September 2025** from Katrin Sommer.

The post-mortem says it was raised in October, but the record is dated 18 September. Either an October escalation was never logged, or the note is recalling the date loosely.

Treat 18 September as the date the CRM can stand behind.
